text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Cap Dagangan (Penepian dan Pengubahsuaian Fi) 2020.

(2)  Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2021.

Takrifan

2. Bagi maksud Peraturan -Peraturan ini, "langkah -langkah pengawalan  atau
pencegahan" ertinya  langkah-langkah yang ditetapkan, dibuat dan diambil di bawah
Akta Pencegahan dan Pengawalan Penyakit Berjangkit 1988 [ Akta 342] yang bertujuan
untuk mengawal atau mencegah merebaknya Penyakit Koronavirus 2019 (COVID-19).

Penepian fi

3. (1)   Fi yang dikenakan kepada mana -mana individu, perkongsian, persatuan,
pertubuhan perbadanan atau institusi di bawah Jadual Pertama Peraturan-Peraturan
Cap Dagangan 2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019] diketepikan bagi perkara yang berikut:

(a) berhubung dengan butiran 7, permohonan pindaan nama atau
alamat rumah pemohon dan pembetulan nama atau alamat rumah
tuan punya berdaftar;

(b) berhubung dengan butiran 27, permohonan pelanjutan masa bagi
prosiding lain selain bangkangan; dan

(c) berhubung dengan butiran 32, pemfailan dokumen secara manual.

 (2) Penepian di bawah perenggan 1 (a) dan (b) hendaklah terpakai bagi
mana-mana individu, perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau institusi
yang terkesan dengan langkah-langkah pengawalan  atau pencegahan dan tertakluk
kepada peraturan 4.

Permohonan bagi penepian fi

4. (1) Permohonan bagi penepian fi di bawah perenggan 3(1)(a) dan (b)
hendaklah—
(a) dibuat dalam borang yang ditentukan oleh Pendaftar;

(b) dibuat dalam tempoh antara 1 Januari 2021 hingga 30 Jun 2021; dan

(c) disertakan dengan dokumen sokongan untuk membuktikan
bahawa:

(i) bagi apa-apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh individu:

(A) pemohon adalah daripada kumpulan B40 yang layak
untuk menerima Bantuan Sara Hidup atau Bantuan
Prihatin Nasional; atau

(B) pendapatannya terkesan de ngan langkah -langkah
pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(ii) bagi apa -apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh mana -mana
perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau
institusi pemohon:

(A) telah memperoleh kelulusan bagi penyambungan
moratorium atau apa -apa fleksibiliti pembayaran
balik daripada mana-mana institusi kewangan;

(B) mempunyai masalah aliran tunai akibat
langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(C) menghadapi keberhutangan dan kesulitan membuat
pembayaran balik hutang akibat langkah -langkah
pengawalan atau pencegahan.

(2) Jika permohonan bagi pendaftaran cap dagangan atau cap dagangan
berdaftar mempunyai lebih daripada seorang tuan punya , kehendak di bawah
subperenggan 1(c)(i) atau (ii) disifatkan telah dipatuhi jika salah seorang tuan punya
mematuhi kehendak tersebut.

Pengubahsuaian fi

5. (1) Tertakluk kepada peraturan 6 , fi yang dikenakan kepada mana -mana
individu, perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau institusi yang terkesan
oleh langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan di bawah  Peraturan-Peraturan Cap
Dagangan 2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019 ] bagi butiran dan perkara yang dinyatakan dalam
ruang (1) dan ruang (2) Jadual diubah suai sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam
ruang (3).

 (2) Pengubahsuaian fi di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah terpakai bagi
pendaftaran cap dagangan yang habis tempoh antara 1 Januari 2021 hingga 30 Jun 2021.

Permohonan bagi pengubahsuai fi

6. (1) Permohonan bagi pengubahsuaian fi di bawah subperaturan  5(1)
hendaklah—

(a) dibuat dalam borang yang ditentukan oleh Pendaftar;

(b) dibuat dalam tempoh enam bulan selepas tarikh habis tempoh
pendaftaran yang disebut dalam subseksyen 39(5) Akta; dan

(c) disertakan dengan dokumen sokongan untuk membuktikan
bahawa:

(i) bagi apa-apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh individu:

(A) pemohon adalah daripada kumpulan B40 yang layak
untuk menerima Bantuan Sara Hidup atau Bantuan
Prihatin Nasional; atau

(B) pendapatannya terkesan dengan langkah -langkah
pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(ii) bagi apa -apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh mana -mana
perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau
institusi pemohon:

(A) telah memperoleh kelulusan bagi penyambungan
moratorium atau apa -apa fleksibiliti pembayaran
balik daripada mana-mana institusi kewangan;

(B) mempunyai masalah aliran tunai akibat
langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(C) menghadapi keberhutangan dan kesulitan membuat
pembayaran balik hutang akibat langkah -langkah
pengawalan atau pencegahan.

(2) Jika permohonan bagi pendaftaran cap dagangan atau cap dagangan
berdaftar mempunyai lebih daripada seorang tuan punya , kehendak di bawah
subperenggan 1 (c)(i) atau (ii)  disifatkan telah dipatuhi jika salah seorang tuan punya
mematuhi kehendak tersebut.

TRADEMARKS ACT 2019

TRADEMARKS (WAIVER AND MODIFICATION OF FEE) REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred b y paragraph 162 (2) (f) of the
Trademarks Act 2019 [Act 815], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1)  These regulations may be cited as the  Trademarks
(Waiver and Modification of Fee) Regulations 2020.

 (2)  These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2021.

Interpretation
2. For the purpose of these R egulations, " control or prevention measures " means
measures prescribed, made or taken under the Prevention and Control of Infectious
Diseases Act 1988  [Act 342 ] intended to control or prevent the spread of the
Coronavirus Diseases 2019 (COVID-19).

Waiver of fee
3.  (1) The fees imposed to any individual, partnership, association,
body corporate or institution under the First Schedule of the Trademarks
Regulations 2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019] are waived for the following matters:

(a) in respect of item 7, application for amendment of name or address
of applicant  and correction of name or address of registered
proprietor;

(b) in respect of item  27, request for extension of time for  other than
opposition proceedings; and

(c) in respect of  item 32,  filing of document manually.

(2) The waiver under paragraphs 1 (a) and (b) shall apply to  any individual,
partnership, association, body corporate or institution affected with the control or
prevention measures and subject to regulation 4.

Application for waiver of fee
4. (1) An application for a waiver of fees under paragraphs 3(1) (a) and (b)
shall be—
(a) made in the form as determined by the Registrar;

(b) made within the period of  1 January 2021 until 30 June 2021; and

(c) accompanied with the supporting document to prove that—

(i) for any application made by an individual:

(A) the applicant is from the B40 group who is entitled for
the Household Living Aid or Prihatin National Aid; or

(B) his income is affected with the control or prevention
measures; or

(ii) for any application made by any partnership, association,
body corporate or institution, the applicant:

(A) has obtained approval for the extension of
moratorium or any repayment flexibility from any
financial institution;

(B) has cash flow problem affected with the control or
prevention measures; or

(C) has pecuniary indebtedness and p roblem on
repayment of debts affected with the control or
prevention measures.

(2) If an application for registration of trademark or a registered trademark
has more than one proprietor the requirements under subparagraphs (1)(c)(i) or (ii)
are deemed to be complied with if one of the proprietors satisfies such requirements.

Modification of fee
5.  (1) Subject to regulation 6, the fee  imposed to any individual, partnership,
association, body corporate or institution affected with the control or prevention
measures in the Trademarks Regulations 2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019 ] for item
and matter  as specified in column (1) and column (2) of the Schedule is modified as
specified in column (3).

 (2) The modificat ion of fee  under subregulation  (1) shall be applied to
the registration of trademark which expires between 1 January 2021 until 30 June 2021.

Application for modification of fee
6. (1) An application for modification of fee under subregulation 5(1) shall be—

(a) made in the form as determined by the Registrar;

(b) made within the period of six months after the date of expiry
of registration referred to in subsection 39(5) of the Act; and

(c) accompanied with the supporting document to prove that—

(i) for any application made by an individual:

(A) the applicant is from the B40 group who is entitled for
the Household Living Aid or Prihatin National Aid; or

(B) his income is affected with the control or prevention
measures; or

(ii) for any application made by any partnership, association,
body corporate or institution the applicant:

(A) has obtained approval for the extension of
moratorium or any repayment flexibility from any
financial institution;

(B) has cash flow problem  affected with the control or
prevention measures; or

(C) has pecuniary indebtedness and problem on
repayment of debts affected with the control or
prevention measures.

(2) If an application for registration of trademark or a registered trademark
has more than one proprietor the requirements under subparagraphs (1)(c)(i) or (ii)
 are deemed to be complied with if one of the proprietors satisfies such requirements.
